method.scope: Remove post-notify parser sleep; keep queue/parse limits and repaint gate
method.machine: Ryzen 7 PRO 4750U; amdgpu 1002:1636; Linux 7.0.12; Neovim 0.12.3; Liberation Mono 14px
method.sampling: same terminal-perf-run.py steady intervals and DRM method as the previous profiling report
method.cpu: host process only; 100% is one core
method.latency: synthetic GPUI dispatch -> actual PTY child -> final response batch -> paint -> GPUI submission; not physical input or compositor presentation
method.profiles: diagnostic traces use dev profile; CPU/GPU comparisons use release with LTO and trace disabled
method.gpu_clock: dynamic, not locked; small GPU differences are not reliable improvements
method.excluded_reason: window moved or visibility changed; excluded entirely, including latency
